model_selection: Leave one training instance out, keeping all seeds grouped; maximize mean selected-solver HV at total_budget minus probe FE
training_cases: Same 18 cases as the static selector campaign
evaluation_cases: Same 13 cases as the static selector campaign; no evaluation outcomes used to fit or select probe policy
budget_accounting: Probe both solvers, preserve state, continue one; selected receives 3000-probe FE and other receives probe FE
cooperation: Passive Pareto archive union; no injection
